note: Structured record of the Mendo Love Farms THCV genetics reconciliation, extracted from the DPP prototype passports published 2026-09-10/11. Source of record for any StrainChain passport surface. Every numeric field here is transcribed from an SC Labs certificate of analysis; every prose claim is tagged with its provenance. Discrepancies are recorded, never silently resolved — see reconciliation.md.
provenance_warning: Transcribed from the published prototype passports, which are themselves a reconciliation of the source CoA PDFs. The original SC Labs PDFs have NOT been re-read against this file. Treat every value as 'verified against the prototype', not 'verified against the certificate', until that pass is done.

method.decarboxylation_note: Molar ratio of THC (314.46) to THCA (358.47) = 0.8772. total_thcv = THCV + THCVA * 0.877; total_thc = d9_THC + THCA * 0.877.
method.verification: All eight certificate rows were recomputed from raw mg/g. Every published total and ratio reproduces exactly except LT-35 #10 — see discrepancies.
method.moisture_note: Breeder, email "VT 26" 2026-09-06: "you will see high moisture on our COA's because we test fresh leaf/ flower since gauging THCV levels for harvest. The California State fair entry is at the proper moisture levels." This explains moisture of 70-86% across the set against 11.6% on the State Fair flower entry — the samples are deliberately fresh-tested, not mishandled. Analysis is dry-weight, so totals remain comparable.

Follows from the three confirmed LT edges: (VT-26) x (VT-26 x VT-41) is a backcross toward VT-26/VT-41, not a simple two-parent F1. The inference is sound; the breeder has not confirmed this framing directly.

Mike, email 2026-09-10 (subject "Lineage"): "The VT 26 female and the VT 41 male were grown out in 2024, LT 11, LT 17 and LT 57 are there male offspring that were grown out in 2025 and used for breeding purposes. LT 35 and LT 63 are females from that cross, that we have clones of." LT-35 is therefore a full sibling of the LT males, not a separate line. Supersedes the earlier reading of "no parentage on file", which was correct only because this email had not yet been read.
